Markets.title: Global Market:  BOJ seen nearing 2% inflation target as markets eye December rate hike
Markets.summary: The Bank of Japan may soon signal that its 2% inflation target has been reached, driven by steady wages, rising prices, and a weak yen. This development strengthens market expectations for a potential interest rate hike in December as monetary policy normalizes.

Markets.title: Why junk bonds deliver equity-like returns but with far inferior volatility, explains Saurabh Mukherjea
Markets.summary: High-yield bonds have historically provided equity-like returns with lower volatility. Saurabh Mukherjea explains that their coupons, seniority in repayment, and diversification benefits make them useful portfolio additions.

Markets.title: SRIT India shares hit 5% upper circuit after strong debut, jump 19% from IPO price. Should you buy, sell or hold?
Markets.summary: SRIT India shares jumped 19% from their IPO price after making a strong debut on the NSE. Analysts note that future investment decisions should depend on the company's revenue growth, profitability, execution, and cash flows.

Markets.title: Ambani’s Jio said to seek about Rs 11 lakh crore valuation in IPO
Markets.summary: Reliance Industries is reportedly targeting a valuation of about Rs 11 lakh crore for an initial public offering of its Jio Platforms unit. The telecom and digital services arm could launch the share sale the week of October 19 and list before October 30.

Markets.title: Orient Cables shares tumble 10% a day after strong market debut
Markets.summary: Orient Cables shares fell 10% following their strong IPO debut, though the stock remains above the initial issue price of Rs 272. Analysts are advising investors to assess the company's financial health and operational strategies regarding future revenue and profitability.

Markets.title: Banks vs NBFCs: Which stocks could benefit as RBI set to hike rates for the first time in 3 years?
Markets.summary: An expected RBI rate hike will likely increase funding costs for NBFCs while benefiting lenders with floating-rate assets and strong liquidity. Brokerages currently favor top financial stocks including HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Bajaj Finance, and Tata Capital.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump stated that an unspecified "threat" prompted the U.S. military to withdraw B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in England. The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday that the aircraft have returned to their home stations in the United States.

Geo-Political.title: France braces for national day of school protests after injuries and mass arrests
Geo-Political.summary: France is preparing for a national day of school protests following recent injuries and mass arrests. Students are demonstrating to demand increased financial investment in the country's education system.

Geo-Political.title: Saudi Arabia urged to spare man sentenced to death over Facebook post
Geo-Political.summary: Anojan Sivarasa has been sentenced to death in Saudi Arabia after being convicted of blasphemy over a Facebook comment. Human rights advocates are now urging the Saudi government to spare his life.

Geo-Political.title: Separatist party projected to win Quebec election, adding new test to Canada's unity
Geo-Political.summary: The Parti Québécois is projected to win the Quebec election and has secured a minority government. The separatist party has vowed to hold a referendum on independence in the coming years.

Geo-Political.title: Nigeria mourns as 32 killed when military plane crashes into swamp
Geo-Political.summary: A military plane crash in Nigeria killed 32 people and prompted national mourning. President Bola Tinubu called the tragic incident a painful moment for the country and its armed forces.

Geo-Political.title: Europe is pouring billions into space. Can Glasgow's satellite industry keep up?
Geo-Political.summary: Europe is investing billions of euros into its space sector. This funding boom raises questions about whether Glasgow's satellite industry can compete and what role the state should play in supporting the sector.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is emerging as a powerful alternative to traditional SEO for generating organic traffic.

AI & Tech.summary: Artificial intelligence tools have become essential for digital creators looking to stay ahead of the curve in 2025. This guide highlights the top ten AI applications designed to revolutionize and simplify the content creation process.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps creators produce digital media. The tool also provides features for users to share and monetize their creations.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why the RBI looks set to hike rates
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise the repo rate due to mounting inflation, rising oil prices, and global monetary tightening. These pressures are forcing the central bank to take action.

Data & Insights.title: World Bank raises India FY27 growth forecast to 7.1% from 6.6% on stronger-than-expected activity
Data & Insights.summary: The World Bank raised India's economic growth forecast for the 2027 fiscal year to 7.1 percent from 6.6 percent. This upgrade is driven by strong domestic demand and exports, though the World Bank cautions that elevated global risks remain.

Data & Insights.title: Ecuador in talks with India for sale of crude oil, critical minerals, copper: ambassador Buchelli
Data & Insights.summary: Ecuador is in discussions with India to sell crude oil, critical minerals, and copper. This move aligns with India's efforts to diversify its energy imports away from war-stricken West Asia.

Data & Insights.title: India’s services sector growth hits three-month high: PMI survey
Data & Insights.summary: India's services sector growth reached a three-month high due to stronger sales performance. Companies benefited from rising demand across digital solutions, finance, software, and travel.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting rescheduled for Thursday, says official order
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council meeting in New Delhi has been rescheduled to Thursday. Officials state the meeting will focus on process reforms and compliance simplification instead of rate changes.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting postponed for second time, rescheduled to October 8
Data & Insights.summary: The 57th GST Council meeting has been postponed for a second time and is now rescheduled to October 8. The meeting will focus on proposed changes to GST registration, returns, and refund mechanisms.

India.title: "Gyanesh, It's Done, Bro": Rahul Gandhi As He Leads March To Election Commission's Office
India.summary: Rahul Gandhi led an opposition INDIA bloc protest march toward the Election Commission's office in New Delhi. During the march, he made a comment addressing Gyanesh, stating that it was done.

India.title: North Section Of Mumbai Airport's Terminal 1B To Be Redeveloped, Some Flights To Be Shifted To Navi Mumbai
India.summary: Redevelopment of the north section of Mumbai Airport's Terminal 1B will begin in January 2027 to increase capacity from 15 million to 20 million passengers per annum. During this project, some flights will be shifted to Navi Mumbai.

India.title: INDIA Bloc Protest LIVE: Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Released Minutes After Detention
India.summary: Leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi were released shortly after being detained during an opposition protest in India. The DMK and the Aam Aadmi Party boycotted the march to the Election Commission office.

India.title: Rahul Gandhi Climbs Barricade In Massive INDIA Bloc Protest Against Gyanesh Kumar
India.summary: Rahul Gandhi climbed a barricade during a massive protest led by the INDIA bloc on Tuesday. The alliance marched from Parliament to the Election Commission headquarters to protest against Gyanesh Kumar.

India.title: Navi Mumbai Airport Expands Inflight Catering With TajSATS Ahead Of Winters
India.summary: Navi Mumbai Airport has partnered with TajSATS to expand its inflight catering services ahead of the winter season. This collaboration aims to provide airlines with greater flexibility to meet rising passenger demand and improve the overall dining experience.

India.title: Video Shows Utensils Being Washed On Bathroom Floor At Chhattisgarh Sweet Shop, Triggers Probe
India.summary: A video shows utensils being washed on a bathroom floor at a sweet shop in Chhattisgarh. The employee blamed the incident on an emergency water supply disruption, and authorities have launched a probe.

General.summary: France is preparing for a national day of school protests following recent student injuries and mass arrests. The demonstrators are demanding increased government investment in the education system.

General.title: Author and former politician Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86
General.summary: Author and former politician Jeffrey Archer has died at the age of 86. During his five-decade writing career, he sold more than 300 million books.

General.title: Rise in babies in care proceedings raises fears of unnecessary adoptions, experts tell BBC
General.summary: Experts warn that a rising number of babies entering care proceedings could lead to unnecessary adoptions. A BBC investigation indicates that many of these infants might have remained with their families if better support had been provided.

General.title: MPs call for investigation after Lutnick-Epstein whistleblower dies
General.summary: Simon Andriesz said he felt let down by the UK's Financial Conduct Authority before his death last month.
